overall_design: Make the London hotel reservation a prerequisite for the check-out reminder by embedding a note from the concierge that the London AI Summit hotel (River Thames views, May 28–30) must be confirmed before departure. The concierge email points to the London AI Summit email, which contains the detailed task. The two sites repeat the same core dependency: the check-out reminder is incomplete without the London hotel booking, and the conference email provides the exact instructions to review and reserve the hotel with River Thames views.
